titulo.es: El rial iraní toca un mínimo histórico mientras Trump amenaza con una "guerra económica"
titulo.en: Canada vows ‘dollar for dollar’ response as US puts 50% tariffs on some goods

sintesis.es: Mientras Estados Unidos amenaza con nuevas sanciones contra Irán, el rial iraní cayó a un mínimo histórico frente al dólar, según medios locales. Las autoridades iraníes relativizaron la amenaza de Donald Trump, quien dijo que libraría una "guerra económica" contra Teherán. Los residentes en la capital tienen opiniones encontradas sobre cómo debería actuar el Gobierno.
sintesis.en: Collapse of trade talks could lead to job losses, but biggest impact on traditional allies is expected to be political The US has imposed 50% tariffs on some goods from Canada, and Mark Carney, the country’s prime minister, has vowed to match them “dollar for dollar” after the collapse of trade talks. The tariffs came into force on roughly $20bn (£14.6bn) of goods – ranging from hockey sticks to tongue depressors – at 04.00GMT. Trade experts said the tariffs could result in some job losses, but the largest impact is expected to be political, driving a further wedge between the traditional allies.

titulo.es: Israeli settler attacks shift focus to West Bank areas under direct Palestinian rule
titulo.en: Israeli settler attacks shift focus to West Bank areas under direct Palestinian rule

sintesis.es: Report says violence is moving from Israeli-controlled areas to those earmarked for a future Palestinian state Violent Israeli settler attacks in the two areas of the occupied West Bank under direct Palestinian rule have almost doubled since 2025, as settlers pursue a self-proclaimed “great settlement revolution” in the very heart of the territory earmarked for a Palestinian state. According to a report by the Israeli human rights organisation Yesh Din , shared with the Guardian, data shows that almost two-thirds of incidents of settler violence so far in 2026 have taken place in the so-called Areas A and B – placed under Palestinian Authority governance in the 1995 Oslo accords. titulo.es: ¿Por qué cuatro cometas desencadenan otra amenaza de ofensiva de Israel contra la devastada Gaza?
titulo.en: ‘Shameful’: UK, Australia and Canada criticise Israel over Gaza aid convoy killings decision

sintesis.es: Cuatro cometas fueron encontradas en la comunidad israelí de Nahal Oz sin explosivos ni materiales peligrosos. Hamás afirma que fueron lanzados por niños, mientras que Israel los considera una amenaza y advierte que intensificará sus operaciones en Gaza si se repiten los episodios. Cerca de 21.300 menores de edad, según datos locales, han muerto en este territorio palestino por los ataques israelíes desde el 7 de octubre de 2023.
sintesis.en: Joint statement issued after IDF said it will not pursue criminal investigations into April 2024 strike that killed seven humanitarian workers Britain, Australia and Canada have called the decision of the Israeli military authorities not to open a criminal investigation into the April 2024 airstrikes that hit a convoy of aid vehicles in Gaza “shameful”. The strikes killed seven humanitarian workers from the US-based World Central Kitchen (WCK) organisation. WCK staff from the three countries were among the casualties of the attack, which prompted global outrage.

titulo.es: Hong Kong condena a los guardianes de la memoria de Tiananmen por pedir el fin de la "dictadura de partido único" en China
titulo.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’

sintesis.es: Los antiguos líderes del grupo que durante tres décadas organizó las multitudinarias vigilias del 4 de junio son declarados culpables de incitar a la subversión Leer
sintesis.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date.

titulo.es: Landslide at waste mound in Guinea capital kills 30, government says
titulo.en: Landslide at waste mound in Guinea capital kills 30, government says

sintesis.es: Dump site in Conakry, which minister had just promised to move, collapsed after heavy rain in west African state A ⁠landslide at a huge waste dump in Guinea’s capital has killed 30 people, the government said on Sunday, after heavy rains overnight prompted it to ⁠collapse, engulfing nearby tents and shacks. The incident occurred less than a week after the government announced plans to close the ⁠site and relocate the waste because of the threat it posed, especially during the rainy season, which causes landslides and fatal flash ⁠floods each year in crowded, underdeveloped cities across parts of West Africa. titulo.es: Muere a los 92 años Nancy Kissinger, viuda y consejera del histórico ex secretario de Estado Henry Kissinger
titulo.en: Spain's Secretary of State for Health discusses health priorities with WHO

sintesis.es: Considerada la consejera más cercana de su marido durante los años clave de la Guerra Fría, ejerció una notable influencia entre bambalinas en la política exterior estadounidense sin ostentar nunca un cargo diplomático formal Leer
sintesis.en: WHO welcomed Mr Javier Padilla Bernáldez, Spain’s Secretary of State for Health and his delegation on 23 and 24 April 2024 to discuss joint global health priorities. Amongst others, Spain's focus is on universal health coverage and health systems strengthening; pandemic response and emergency medical teams; organ and tissue transplantation; malaria and other tropical diseases; and polio. During the visit, participants focused on plans and on-going work across a number of areas, including WHO’s Transplantation Program to increase availability; ethical access and oversight of transplantation of human cells; tissues and organs.
